steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato into 2 cm cubes; finely dice the onion; mince the garlic and ginger.
Start the rice in a medium saucepan according to package directions; keep warm.
Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until softened and translucent.
Add the garlic, ginger, turmeric and cumin; stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and crushed tomatoes; add the sweet potato and stir to combine.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 12 minutes, until the sweet potato is just tender.
Cut the white fish (cod, haddock) into 4 cm chunks; nestle into the sauce.
Cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Stir in the lemon juice; serve over rice — about 20 portions · 4 family portions; keeps refrigerated up to 2 days.
